item.text: {"summary":"The supplied implementation and assertions identify the cause: Status::ToString ignores its requested mode and always passes kWithEverything, while StatusRep::ToString enables payload output only when the mode equals kWithPayload. Consequently, both default and explicit rendering omit payloads. The evidence is sufficient for a concrete source repair.","hypotheses":["Status::ToString discards its mode argument, so callers cannot select the requested payload visibility.","StatusRep::ToString treats the mode as an exact value instead of checking whether the payload flag is set; kWithEverything therefore omits payloads."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
